pages.title: Three in a Jug
pages.text: Fill a Jug with at least two different supported teas and drink from it.

pages.title: Three in a Jug
pages.text: Combine tea effects in one portable serving.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: A Jug accepts up to three different teas. It combines their native effects; a Flask follows a separate potion recipe.

pages.title: Combine tea in a jug
pages.text: A Jug holds up to three different teas and lets you drink them together. This combines tea effects rather than following the Flask's potion recipe.

pages.title: Select a tea for the task
pages.text: Green, Oolong, Black, Lavender and Hibiscus teas and coffee provide different support. Read the selected drink's tooltip; coffee's depth-related behavior is not universal mining speed.
